C0465.title: Woman Sentenced for Repeated Fraud Using Fake Transfer Records
C0465.summary: Between 2020 and 2021, a woman surnamed Ma defrauded online stores by using fabricated Alipay transfer screenshots to order cosmetics and other goods, including over 4,000 yuan worth of cosmetics from a victim surnamed Wan. Ma was convicted and sentenced for fraud.

references.title: Woman sentenced for repeated fraud using fake transfer records in 'empty-handed scheme'
